messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Ownership of the job scheduler transferred from the Dune team to the Cinder team on 2025-09-23. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- The Cinder team owns the job scheduler as of 2025-09-23, when ownership transferred from the Dune team. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the job scheduler as of 2025-09-05. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not the Dune team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- The job scheduler is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-25, when ownership moved from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-scheduler]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- On 2026-05-22, the Dune team observed that the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-3]
- Cinder runs its planning on Mondays. [valid 2026-04-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-04-03]
- As of 2025-11-27, Diego is on the Ember team, having left Cinder. [valid 2025-11-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-27]
    earlier: Diego is on Cinder. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-27; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-10-16, the Cinder team sits on the third floor. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-16]
- The Cinder team observed on 2025-05-14 that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-05-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-14]
- The Dune team observed on 2025-08-19 that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19-2]
- The Ember team handed the authentication gateway to Cinder on 2025-09-16; Cinder owns it as of that date. [decision; valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the authentication gateway. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-09-16; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- Cinder adopted trunk-based development as of 2025-05-14. [decision; valid 2025-05-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-14-2]
- On 2026-03-11, the Cinder team noticed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2]
- As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by Cinder; ownership transferred from the Atlas team on that date. [decision; valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-17, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-07-17 to 2025-10-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-17]
    earlier: The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-07-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-11, when ownership passed from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by Cinder as of 2025-06-11, when ownership passed from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- The Dune team adopted a monthly game day as of 2025-04-21. [decision; valid 2025-04-21 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-21]
- As of 2025-06-06, the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node. [decision; valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-06]
- As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder, not the Atlas team. [constraint; valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- As of 2025-11-27, Diego Alvarez is on the Ember team, having left Cinder. [valid 2025-11-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-27]
- On 2025-12-19, the Atlas team took over the product catalog from the Cinder team. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
